test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six numbers, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, are written on the different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown (Figures 1 - 3). Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing ‘3’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cbfb467b50a3208787d91450196e7da8427f9b2eff43aa9901010f914a60b1a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 3 is common on both the dices figure 1 and figure 2, it is clear that 6, 2, 5, and 4 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 1 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a086349017e375ec103472f38536eb24c25572703f2227428b9b065e7a10c35.png] 

Opposite pairs:

6 → 5

2 → 4

3 → 1

So, the opposite side of "3" will be side "1".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
